independence: Independent auditor: agent role i18n-auditor, a different agent from the translator (i18n-translator, per the translation records read here). None of the 31 audited strings was authored by this run. Five of them were FIXED by this run after the audit recorded them, at the operator's direction: es ui.ownerAudit.read_only (plural agreement), hi ui.ownerAudit.viewers_label and ui.ownerAudit.disclosure (label form and legal register), vi and zh-CN ui.teamBridge.thread.not_available (open vs access). Each fix is recorded in resolved_findings with before and after text, and every sha256 in this receipt names the POST-fix bytes now in the tree, so the receipt audits what ships rather than what preceded the fix. The ledger rows were written by scripts/i18n/ledger-assemble.mjs, never by hand. Every sha256 was recomputed from the files in this worktree.
